verdict.rationale: Rootly documents live AI-generated summaries (AI Summaries drafting from timeline, alerts, Slack, transcripts; /rootly summary command), automatically drafted retrospective sections (Summary, Impact, Root Cause, etc.) from Slack channel and bridge-call transcripts, AI blocks that draft retro sections in-editor, and Meeting Scribe which joins the bridge automatically to produce a live, searchable, speaker-labeled record — directly matching live summaries, drafted updates, and scribed call notes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of accuracy and real-time latency of these AI features beyond vendor docs.
